description: A single tappable settings list row: leading icon chip, title + optional subtitle, trailing value/status/chevron or switch. Replaces the local Row in settings.tsx. Fully tokenized against design-system.ts.

icon.description: Leading glyph rendered in the icon chip

status.description: Drives icon-chip tint + trailing status; always paired with statusLabel/glyph so it is color-independent

statusLabel.description: Short word shown in the status color when status != default (e.g. '2 new', 'Needs attention')

badgeCount.description: Numeric pill on the right (e.g. linked-account error count), colors.error fill / colors.text

onPress.description: Row tap handler; if absent and accessory is chevron, render 'none'

destructive.description: Renders the log-out variant (error-tinted full-width button)

accessibility.label: {title}{, subtitle}{, value/statusLabel}
accessibility.switchState: accessibilityState.checked reflects switchValue; announces on change
accessibility.target: whole row >= 48pt (>= 44pt min); switch row target is the full row, not just the thumb
accessibility.colorIndependence: every non-default status renders a glyph (●/⚠) + a word alongside the color
